question.text:
Given below are two statement : one is labelled as Assertion A and the other is labelled as Reason R.
Assertion A:SO2( g) is adsorbed to a large extent than H2( g) on activated charcoal.

Reason R : SO2( g) has a higher critical temperature than H2( g)

In the light of the above statements, choose the most appropriate answer from the options given below.

options.text:
Both A and R are correct but R is not the
correct explanation fo A

Both A and R are correct and R is the correct
explanation of A.

<math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">A</mi></math> is not correct but <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">R</mi></math> is correct.

<math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">A</mi></math> is correct but <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">R</mi></math> is not correct.

solution.text: Gases having higher critical temperatures have greater extent of intermolecular force of attractions and those gases readily adsorb on the activated charcoal.
